method: Six-arm sequential cyclic profile, 5M allocations/profile, six fresh-process repetitions per arm, nursery capacities 262136 (offset) and 262144 (aligned). Timing summaries are descriptive; do not treat as statistical significance. Custom survival is copied payload / nursery payload. Final live payload / total allocated payload is reported separately.

header.label: offset
header.environment_policy: remove all inherited environment variables whose names start with GC_; inherit all others; no CPU affinity or explicit heap cap
header.timing_boundary: heap_init and prepare_workload/layout descriptor setup are outside elapsed_seconds. The timer starts immediately before workload() and stops after it returns; workload includes the profile allocation/store/traversal/checksum computation and final major_collect(). The checksum assertion, stats formatting, getrusage(), and heap_destroy() are outside the timed interval.
header.schedule: six cyclic rotations; each arm occupies each of six positions once per profile

checks: Exact semantic allocation counts, payload totals and arithmetic checksums match every sample.
Six cyclic orders and balanced execution positions match every row.
Recorded frozen source, binary and generated-adapter hashes match; baseline gc.c matches git show c324af5a926c7e65a4aede0844de459616c6e8f2.
All four embedded variant patches reconstruct the exact recorded gc.c hashes at both capacities; combined matches the implemented source.
Every minimum, median, range, best-Boehm selection and timing ratio was independently recomputed and matches.
Both embedded measurement-script fulltexts match their SHA-256 records.
independent_review.code_review: No material finding: promotion copies initialized logical payload before forwarding publication, with no collector safepoint inside mature allocation; direct-old and padding zeroing remain intact; all reserved-storage growth and logical peaks remain accounted.

valgrind.result: All exited zero with zero Memcheck errors, zero suppressions and zero outstanding heap blocks.

independent_review.documentation_review: Appended medians and rounded percentages match the artifacts. Synthetic-workload limits, inconsistent short-lived results, previous minima versus current medians, and application candidates as unmeasured integration targets are explicit.
